_about: Structural ceilings for the STABILISATION release only (migrations 1023, 1025 without hq_studio_lately, 1027, 1028), measured with npm run forensics:probe against a replica at production's true schema (0891 plus 0897-0905) seeded by scripts/isolated/seed-production-scale.sql. Counts, never timings. It names only the paths this release changes or must not worsen. The paths it does NOT change (hq_studio_lately, studio_activity, the worker's over-budget deferral, dispatch, idle pass, model_order) are absent on purpose: they are in later migrations and a ceiling for them would claim a result this release does not deliver. Use it as: npx tsx scripts/forensics/resource-probe.ts <replica> --budget=scripts/forensics/resource-budget.stabilisation.json --only=<the names below>.
